scoring_justification: Headline quantities are deterministic outputs of a DFT calculation; recomputing from raw DFT outputs is infeasible in the verifier sandbox. Compare reported numbers to paper gold with generous tolerances to allow for code/functional spread.

hidden_assets.purpose: Paper-reported values for deintercalation voltage, Ni magnetic moments, formation energies
hidden_assets.source_provenance: Paper text: de-intercalation voltage 4.22 V, Ni magnetic moments 1.7 μB (Mg1.5Ni0.5TiO4) and 2.1 μB (MgNi0.5TiO4), formation energies -0.97 eV/f.u. (rutile) and -17.315 eV/f.u. (anatase).
hidden_assets.generation_method: Extracted from the paper's conclusion and results sections.
hidden_assets.why_not_fabricated: These are the actual reported values, used as hidden targets with tolerance to accommodate different DFT implementations.

outputs.description: Scored JSON file containing the computed de-intercalation voltage, Ni magnetic moments, and formation energies of Mg1.5Ni0.5TiO4 per formula unit.

output_contract.notes: All quantities are computed from DFT total energies and magnetic moments obtained using an open-source code (e.g., Quantum ESPRESSO) with appropriate pseudopotentials. The chemical potential of Mg metal can be taken from a standard reference or computed. The formation energies use total energies of the precursor oxides per the paper's reaction stoichiometry.
